design_reason: The first prequential challenger reduced fold1 aggregate bias but regressed both fold2 losses. Add one fixed uncertainty-scaled L1 penalty to avoid reacting to weak prior-game residuals. No lookback, ridge, multiplier or subgroup search.
penalty: lambda=2*sqrt(max(G/(G-1)*sum_g(R_g-n_g*R/N)^2, sum_i p_i*(1-p_i))). R_g=sum_i_in_g(y_i-p_i). The second term floors the empirical game-residual variance. The objective adds lambda*abs(intercept) to the prior Bernoulli-plus-ridge objective.
history_and_population: Exactly the prior source-replayed seed and validation rows, original dates and base predictions; unchanged 60-day window and two-day simulated lag. Only earlier eligible labels enter fits. All same-date games share one state.
verification: Rehash prior complete output inventory and all consumed source/code pins; exact original and prior-challenger row join; independent game residual/penalty/root reconstruction; future-label perturbation; full original scorecard bins and subgroups for all three candidates; monthly diagnostics retained.
guard: No worse Brier AND log loss versus frozen_monotone in EACH fold; ranking is development-only. Keep previous failed challenger visible.
uncertainty: The game-residual scale is a regularizer, not a confidence interval or false-update guarantee. Original paired whole-game intervals hold realized adaptive predictions fixed; they omit cross-date adaptation dependence and refitting.
limitations: Further adaptive development informed by inspected validation outcomes, not independent confirmation.
No global or subgroup superiority is assumed from this conservative design.
Current source revisions and game-date lag do not establish historical label availability.
No raw xG/model-map refit, source-state correction, MoneyPuck input, legacy deserialization, production change or serving promotion.
All prior runs and prospective reservations remain unchanged; no automatic foundation, FPAR or model acceptance.
